Measured over Libya: 17 of the 22 units have geoBoundaries and Natural Earth reporting identical geometry, and in five of those Natural Earth carries a pre-2007 shabiyah code the register does not hold while geoBoundaries carries the current popularate code (LY-WA on `Ajdabiya`, LY-DR on `Al Qubbah`, LY-JG on `Mizdah`, LY-NL on `Ghadamis`). Four of those five are keys every dataset that codes them agrees on, corroborated by Overture Maps; Tripoli is the fifth and differs only in that Overture Maps has no row for it. The register holds LY-TB `Tarabulus` and no Tajura unit at all, that shabiyah having gone into Tripoli in the 2007 merger of 32 into 22; Natural Earth's LY-TN is not in the register, and its own point test names the polygon `Tripoli District`. Wikidata's Q32837 for LY-TB is `district of Libya` with capital Tripoli, the capital this card names, taken from Statoids' 2007 table. So the card shows the key and is keyed on it (the registry-fields ruling of 2026-09-29 and the card-code rule of 2026-10-21, both by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)).
